answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 21988 Country: Pakistan Title: if some one suck the milk from the breast of his wife after the birth of child and the milk goes down his(husband) troat then what is the kafara of this. Question: if some one suck the milk from the breast of his wife after the birth of child and the milk goes down his(husband) troat then what is the kafara of this. Answer ID: 21988 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 832/661/B=1431) In is not lawful to drink the milk of woman after the childhood, rather it is haram and an act of sin. There is no kaffarah (expiation), just do tauba and istighfar extensively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
